title: Israeli Strikes and Shelling Hit Ten South Lebanon Towns Overnight
detail: Israeli strikes, artillery shelling, and airborne ordnance hit al-Mansouri, Hadatha, Baraashit, Zawtar al-Sharqiyeh, Dhaira, Kfar Remman, Rshaf, Sarbine, Houla, and Jabal al-Qantara overnight into Tuesday, with 'violent explosions' causing structural damage in Jabal al-Qantara. Israeli forces also continued burning and bulldozing homes in several of the targeted villages as part of the ongoing demolition campaign along the border.

title: Lebanese Boy Dies of Wounds from Unexploded Israeli Cluster Bomb in Haboush
detail: A Lebanese boy, Mohammad Ali Ibrahim, succumbed to his wounds after an unexploded Israeli cluster munition detonated in the southern village of Haboush, where he had been injured days earlier along with another child. His father, Ali Ibrahim, had previously been killed in an Israeli attack on south Lebanon. The death underscores the ongoing danger posed by unexploded ordnance left behind by Israeli strikes in villages across the south.

media.caption: Haboush, south Lebanon, where a child died of wounds from an unexploded cluster munition
